source: BUILD_PLAN §11 (product analytics, PostHog). Sent only under analytics consent (purpose analytics), with pseudonymous ids. No session replay on account pages.
notes: Properties are ids, codes, counts and booleans only: never a phone, name, email, address, PAN, free text or a document.
Domain change events (core.events: band_changed, qpr_missing …) are the EventKind enum in schemas/common.schema.json, not analytics events.

events.name: report_viewed
events.description: A risk summary was shown (project page, app risk screen or WhatsApp risk card).

events.name: reason_expanded
events.description: A reason under the band was opened.

events.name: evidence_opened
events.description: The evidence drawer opened for a fact.

events.name: search_submitted
events.description: A search ran (typed or parsed).

events.name: compare_opened
events.description: Compare opened with 2–4 phases.

events.name: share_card_shared
events.description: A share card was sent from the share sheet.

events.name: project_followed
events.description: A buyer followed a phase.

events.name: project_unfollowed
events.description: A buyer unfollowed a phase.

events.name: whatsapp_optin_granted
events.description: WhatsApp utility alerts were turned on.

events.name: alert_prefs_changed
events.description: Alert preferences were saved.

events.name: family_invite_created
events.description: A family invite code was made.

events.name: consent_granted
events.description: A consent row was created by the buyer's tap.

events.name: consent_withdrawn
events.description: A consent was withdrawn.

events.name: number_shared
events.description: The buyer shared their number by their own tap (api.share_my_number).

events.name: claims_checked
events.description: A document check finished.

events.name: answer_feedback
events.description: Thumbs up or down on an Ask Plinth answer.

events.name: cost_sheet_checked
events.description: A cost-sheet document check finished (doc_check kind cost_sheet).

events.name: payee_checked
events.description: A before_you_pay check finished (api.before_you_pay_check or doc_check kind before_you_pay).

events.name: pay_as_built_checked
events.description: A pay-as-built document check finished (doc_check kind pay_as_built).

events.name: check_saved
events.description: The buyer saved a document check to their account (api.doc_check_save).

events.name: adviser_requested
events.description: "Talk to a Plinth adviser" was tapped (ops.review_tasks kind adviser_request).
